name: Power & Utilities
description: Electricity generation from conventional and renewable sources, transmission and distribution infrastructure, and battery energy storage systems.

sub_industries.name: Generation — Conventional
sub_industries.description: Power generation from natural gas, diesel gensets, and backup generator applications.

device_types.name: Generator / Genset
device_types.description: Reciprocating engine or turbine-driven generator for primary or backup power generation.

tags.name: Active Power Output
tags.description: Real power output in kilowatts.

tags.name: Line Voltage L1-L2
tags.description: Line-to-line voltage between phases L1 and L2.

tags.name: Frequency
tags.description: Generator output frequency. Should be 60 Hz (US) or 50 Hz (international).

tags.name: Power Factor
tags.description: Ratio of real power to apparent power. Low PF indicates inductive loading.

tags.name: Run Hours
tags.description: Cumulative engine run hours for maintenance scheduling.

sub_industries.name: Generation — Solar PV
sub_industries.description: Photovoltaic solar power generation including string and central inverters, weather monitoring, and solar tracker systems.

device_types.name: String Inverter
device_types.description: Converts DC power from a string of solar panels to grid-quality AC power.

tags.name: AC Power Output
tags.description: AC real power output in kilowatts.

tags.name: DC Input Voltage
tags.description: DC voltage from the solar string. Varies with irradiance and temperature.

tags.name: DC Input Current
tags.description: DC current from the solar string.

tags.name: AC Output Voltage
tags.description: AC grid-side voltage.

tags.name: Efficiency
tags.description: Conversion efficiency (AC out / DC in). Drops at low loading or high temperatures.

tags.name: Inverter Temperature
tags.description: Internal inverter temperature. High temps cause derating or shutdown.

device_types.name: Weather Station
device_types.description: On-site meteorological monitoring for solar resource assessment and performance ratio calculations.

tags.name: Plane-of-Array Irradiance
tags.description: Solar irradiance in the plane of the array. Primary driver of generation output.

tags.name: Ambient Temperature
tags.description: Air temperature at the site. Used for performance ratio calculations.

tags.name: Module Temperature
tags.description: Solar panel surface temperature. High temps reduce voltage and output power.

tags.name: Wind Speed
tags.description: Wind speed for tracker stow decisions and soiling analysis.

sub_industries.name: Generation — Wind
sub_industries.description: Wind turbine generation monitoring including rotor, nacelle, and electrical systems.

device_types.name: Wind Turbine
device_types.description: Horizontal-axis wind turbine monitoring for performance optimization and predictive maintenance.

tags.name: Wind Speed
tags.description: Hub-height wind speed. Primary input to power curve analysis.

tags.name: Rotor RPM
tags.description: Main rotor rotational speed.

tags.name: Power Output
tags.description: Active power output in kilowatts.

tags.name: Nacelle Temp
tags.description: Nacelle internal temperature. High temps indicate cooling system issues.

tags.name: Blade Pitch
tags.description: Blade pitch angle in degrees. Controls rotor speed and power output.

tags.name: Yaw Position
tags.description: Nacelle yaw angle relative to north. Tracks wind direction.

sub_industries.name: Battery Energy Storage (BESS)
sub_industries.description: Grid-scale battery energy storage systems for peak shaving, frequency regulation, and renewable energy integration.

device_types.name: Battery System
device_types.description: Battery energy storage system rack or string. Monitored for state of charge, electrical parameters, and thermal management.

tags.name: State of Charge
tags.description: Available energy as a percentage of rated capacity.

tags.name: Terminal Voltage
tags.description: Battery terminal voltage.

tags.name: Current
tags.description: Charge/discharge current. Positive = charging, negative = discharging.

tags.name: Cell Temperature
tags.description: Battery cell temperature. Thermal runaway risk above manufacturer thresholds.

tags.name: Power
tags.description: Instantaneous charge/discharge power in kilowatts.

tags.name: State of Health
tags.description: Battery health as a percentage of original rated capacity. Degrades over charge cycles.
